name: pr-review
description: Evidence-backed pull request and change-set review with specialized reviewers.

interface.shortDescription: Review changes with specialized, evidence-checked reviewers.
interface.longDescription: Reviews pull requests and local change sets across applicable code, comments, tests, errors, types, specifications, and optional security analysis, then double-confirms and consolidates the findings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pr-review to review the current pull request or change set.
